lucy_marketing: Quick sync — Solstice Insights interview completed yesterday. Audio + notes uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood/solstice (audio + transcript). Need: quote approval, legal sign-off, and webinar slot. Target embargo week of May 6.

raj_growth: Nice — can we prioritize a customer quote that highlights latency and cost wins? Sales wants to route inbound leads from the webinar into the dedicated demo flow.

oliver_pm: Derek mentioned CTO can do a 1-2 sentence executive blurb. If we have that, we can trim for the hero.

maria_legal: I'll review the transcript. Please also upload the signed release form (we need it on file). Note: avoid absolute performance claims unless Solstice confirms the numbers.

lucy_marketing: Uploaded release form and a doc with 3 suggested quotes here: https://drive.redwood/solstice/quotes. /cc @maria_legal

tony_design: Once copy is locked I’ll make the hero banner + a 60s clip. Need embargo date and final CTA to set up assets.

lucy_marketing: Embargo target: May 10. Proposed CTA: “Join our Solstice webinar — how we cut inference cost by 40%.” That 40% came from Redwood Optimize suggestions though — need Solstice to sign off.

maria_legal: Don’t publish the 40% stat until Solstice confirms. I’ll request an approval for the exact language. Draft note I’m sending them: "We’d like confirmation on any performance figures before publishing; otherwise we’ll keep copy qualitative."

derek_solstice: Happy to approve a short quote: "Redwood reduced our inference costs and made deployments predictable." I’ll run the exact stat with finance and get back to you.

lucy_marketing: :thumbsup: Derek — can you drop one short sentence approval by Thursday? Also need the greenlight on webinar title and promo copy.

raj_growth: Webinar week of May 6 looks good. I recommend Tues 11am PT so APAC can join early afternoon. We’ll tag inbound registrants with `solstice-webinar` and route them to the mid-market demo queue.

casey-deploy-bot: Reminder: assets upload deadline set by marketing schedule — 1716890400 (May 8 17:00 UTC).

maria_legal: Received Derek’s note. I’ll loop in compliance to verify the signed release is sufficient for a public case. ETA tomorrow noon.

lucy_marketing: Great — holding the 40% claim until we get the confirmed stat. Uploading edited promo copy now: https://drive.redwood/solstice/promo.

derek_solstice: Confirmed the quote above. We will send a short approved stat (1 line) by Friday.

lucy_marketing: Thanks everyone — once I have the sentence and legal confirmation I’ll finalize the hero, social blurbs, and webinar landing. Will share final assets in this thread. :rocket:
